name: kotak-neo-pip-terminal
description: Kotak Neo PIP Trading Terminal — Mobile App (iOS IPA & Android APK)

scripts.cap:android: npx cap add android && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:ios: npx cap add ios && npx cap sync ios
scripts.build:ipa: cd ios/App && xcodebuild -workspace App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release archive -archivePath build/App.xcarchive
